story-context.constraints: Follow Toubkal testing strategy (80% coverage minimum) Use Vitest for TypeScript tests, gtest for C++ tests Mock external dependencies appropriately Test privacy compliance throughout Ensure cross-platform compatibility

tests.standards: Unit tests: Vitest + React Testing Library for TypeScript, gtest for C++ components. Integration tests: Template validation and configuration testing. E2E tests: Complete setup process verification with mocked external dependencies. Documentation tests: Example validation and link checking. Privacy tests: Network monitoring during setup process. Security tests: XSS prevention and input sanitization. Performance tests: Bundle size and lighthouse metrics. 80% minimum test coverage across all test types. Mock external dependencies appropriately. Use AAA pattern (Arrange-Act-Assert) for all tests. Result<T> pattern for error handling in tests.
tests.locations: src/test/ - Unit tests for React/TypeScript components and services src/integration/ - Integration tests for service interactions tests/setup/ - Setup process specific test suite src/test/setup-process.test.ts - Unit tests for build scripts src/test/template-validation.test.ts - Template integration tests src/test/e2e-setup.test.ts - End-to-end setup tests src/test/privacy-setup.test.ts - Privacy compliance tests tests/unit/ - C++ unit tests using gtest tests/integration/ - C++ integration tests
tests.ideas: AC1-Unit-tests-build-scripts: Test setup-build.sh functions (platform detection, dependency installation, error handling); mock system calls and external downloads AC2-Integration-tests-templates: Validate .gclient.template parsing, args.gn.template configuration, cross-platform template variations, template error recovery AC3-E2E-tests-setup-process: Test complete setup workflow with mocked Chromium sync, build environment creation, platform-specific setup verification AC4-Documentation-validation-tests: Test all setup documentation examples, validate external links, verify code samples work, check documentation completeness AC5-Privacy-compliance-tests: Network monitoring during setup (zero unsanctioned requests), privacy policy compliance verification, data leakage prevention, external download validation
